finding: tasks repair-closure can successfully stage a closure-packet repair bundle and return a governed git commit command, but the returned git commit path can still fail with ATM_WRITE_TICKET_STALE. A fresh write-ticket acquired through write-ticket acquire is emitted in stdout but is not persisted or accepted by git commit because the commit facade exposes no --ticket bridge.
expectedBehavior: A successful repair-closure mutation should either mint and persist the exact write-ticket required by its returned commit command, or return a copyable reseal/commit command that the git commit adapter can consume without manual native-git fallback.
evidenceOrRepro: During TASK-SKL-0036 pre-push repair, node atm.mjs tasks repair-closure --task TASK-SKL-0036 --scope TASK-SKL-0036 --actor codex-skl-captain --emergency-approval EMG-TASK-SKL-0036-32cd011820 --json staged .atm/history/evidence/TASK-SKL-0036.closure-packet.json, .atm/history/evidence/git-head.jsonl, a repair-closure event, and .atm/history/tasks/TASK-SKL-0036.json. The returned node atm.mjs git commit command failed with ATM_WRITE_TICKET_STALE. Running node atm.mjs write-ticket acquire for the exact staged files succeeded, but a second git commit attempt still failed with ATM_WRITE_TICKET_STALE because the acquired ticket was not connected to the commit wrapper.
followUp: Add adapter-level regression coverage for repair-closure -> fresh write-ticket -> governed commit. Prefer a deep-module fix where repair-closure, write-ticket acquire/check, and git commit share one durable ticket authority instead of exchanging transient stdout-only ticket objects.
